visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black shirt under a light grey cardigan stands before a red wall. A blue and white neon sign saying 'TAIWAN BAR' is mounted behind him. He points his finger upwards while a large red and yellow text overlay appears in the center. (2) The scene cuts to a satellite view of Earth, highlighting the island of Taiwan. It then transitions to a map of South America, specifically focusing on the borders of Argentina and a pinned location. Green terrain and white text labels for various cities are visible. (3) The man returns to the frame, gesturing with his right hand as he speaks. A small black bear plush mascot with a white 'V' on its chest sits on the wooden bar counter to his left. The lighting is warm and indoor-focused. (4) A close-up shot shows a black briefcase opened to reveal many bundles of US currency stacked inside. This is followed by a historical etched portrait of a man with long, curly hair and a ruffled collar, presented in a monochrome style. (5) A close-up of a person's face wearing glasses looking intensely, followed by a top-down view of hands actively writing with a black pen on white papers scattered on a desk next to a coffee mug. The lighting is bright and natural. (6) The man at the bar continues his explanation, moving his hands expressively. He finally picks up the black bear mascot and holds it toward the camera lens. A yellow graphic frame appears around the bear at the very end.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 歷史老師真的問什麼都答得出來嗎. [Logo]: TAIWAN BAR. (2) [Subtitle]: 為什麼福爾摩沙是指臺灣. (3) [Subtitle]: 福爾摩沙其實世界上很多地方都有. (4) [Subtitle]: 像臺灣的對蹠點. (5) [Subtitle]: 就是阿根廷的福爾摩沙省. (6) [Subtitle]: 那為什麼國際間講到福爾摩沙通常就是指臺灣呢. (7) [Slogan]: 這其實跟一個詐騙V.S反詐騙的故事有關. (8) [Subtitle]: 撒瑪納扎. (9) [Subtitle]: 是一個來自法國的猶太人. (10) [Subtitle]: 但是他謊稱自己是來自臺灣的原住民. (11) [Subtitle]: 在英國行騙還唬得英國皇家學會一愣一愣. (12) [Subtitle]: 後來時間久了就被拆穿. (13) [Subtitle]: 很多人就覺得不對啊我真的有去過臺灣就不是這個樣子. (14) [Slogan]: 開始寫很多文章跟證據去反對他. (15) [Subtitle]: 久而久之這些討論都讓福爾摩沙臺灣這個詞彙就連結在一起. (16) [Subtitle]: 可以算是因禍得福囉. (17) [Subtitle]: 好像也可以這麼說但也沒什麼禍啦. (18) [Subtitle]: 這其實在當前的網絡環境大家很好理解嘛. (19) [Subtitle]: 例如說以前講到黑啤你可能會想到是不是黑麥做的啤酒. (20) [Subtitle]: 但你現在想到黑啤就只會. [Variety]: 想到它.
